title: Cosmic Eye Bloom
description: A surreal psychedelic painting features a giant magenta peony with a detailed cosmic eye at its center, dripping yellow liquid into a reflective pool below. A green patterned dog stands on hind legs licking the drips while an orange dragon flies near a swirling galaxy vortex in the starry sky, surrounded by floating flower petals and a colorful woman's face emerging from foliage.
prompt: Surreal psychedelic scene with a giant blooming magenta peony containing a detailed cosmic eye with rainbow iris and silhouettes at its center. The flower drips thick yellow liquid downwards. A green patterned dog stands on hind legs licking the drips. An orange and yellow Chinese dragon flies near a swirling galaxy vortex in a starry black sky. A woman's face with vibrant orange and blue patterns appears among green leaves and flowers on the right. Smaller flowers and petals float throughout the composition.
